name: browser-use
headline: Sindri Legacy - AI-Powered Remote Dev Environments
short_description: This repository contains everything you need to set up a secure, cost-optimized remote development environment running a curated toolset for AI-powered designs, builds, testing, and deployment that's completely customizable on Fly.io infrastructure.
author: pacphi

sections.overview:
Sindri Legacy is a complete AI-powered cloud development environment deployed on Fly.io infrastructure, eliminating the need for local tool installation. It provides a curated toolset for design, building, testing, and deployment with mise-powered extensions for declarative tool management including Node.js, Python, Rust, and Go. The platform features auto-suspend virtual machines for cost optimization, SSH-based remote access, and IDE integration with VSCode and IntelliJ. Developers can deploy fully configured environments using automated setup scripts and manage extensions through an interactive CLI interface. Team collaboration is supported through shared or individual VMs with persistent storage.
Deploy remote development environments without local tool configuration
Reduce cloud infrastructure costs through auto-suspend idle VMs
Access AI-powered coding tools via SSH from any machine
Maintain consistent development tooling across team members using mise extensions
- **Infrastructure**: Fly.io
- **Security**: Secure, optimized for cost
- **Toolset**: Curated for AI-powered workflows
- **Customization**: Fully customizable
